status: selected for first feasibility pilot; not a validated reactor operating point
standard_conversion: ideal-gas molar flow at the reactor paper's standard conditions
thermal_assumption: Gas, inlet gas, wafer and walls all at 110 C; no energy equation or thermal buoyancy in this pilot.
flow_assumption: Full 3D, laminar, constant density, no-slip solid walls; equal flow through four inlet tubes. Steadiness and density approximation require solution checks.
inlet_profile: Uniform normal velocity at the upstream ends of four assumed 10 mm tubes; preserve prescribed integrated flow using actual meshed patch areas. Profile and tube-length sensitivity unresolved.
outlets: Same reference pressure at both exhaust boundaries; outlet split is a result, not prescribed. Review reversed flow before tracer setup.
pressure_convention: Operating absolute pressure selects properties. A future incompressible kinematic p uses zero outlet gauge reference, not 13332 as a direct field value. Absolute pressure deviations in Pa are rho times kinematic p, with any hydrostatic convention stated separately.

tracer.meaning: Fraction of nitrogen carrying an imaginary label introduced at the inlets after a step change; initially 0, inlet 1. Same physical gas on both sides of label front; not precursor concentration, temperature, or deposited film.
tracer.formula: D(T,p) = exp(A+B/T+C*ln(T))*1e-4*(101325/p), m2/s, T in K. Inverse-pressure scaling uses the dilute-gas approximation.
tracer.source_location: NIST TN 2279, printed pages 7-8 (PDF pages 12-13), Table 1a, N2/N2 row
tracer.uncertainty: The nitrogen row does not assign an uncertainty; do not claim a precise percentage. Rounded published fit coefficients are used.
tracer.wall_condition: Impermeable nonreacting wafer and walls: zero normal diffusive label flux. Wafer exposure sampled in gas above surface.
tracer.boundary_balance: Include inlet diffusion in label balance if inlet value is prescribed; outlet treatment must match actual carrier direction.

screening_limits.note: Conservative project screening values, not an accuracy certificate or published acceptance criteria. No universal Reynolds threshold is imposed for this complex chamber.

limitations: This combination is selected from published ranges; not asserted to be an exact published CFD case.
Uniform 110 C differs from Figure 5's helium, 133 Pa, 500 C wafer and 110 C walls.
No reactions, adsorption, plasma, deposition, or thermal gradients.
Actual inlet area, pressure variation, local length scales and steady flow must be checked after meshing and solving.
